Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`; see mips.txt. Code sections also end on a
word: GNU as, and rsasm, pad the end of a code section to its alignment, up
to a word, with no-ops, and llvm-mc does not.

=== branches into another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        bl      helper
        b.w     helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 2
helper:
        bl      entry
        bx      lr
        nop

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        bx      lr
        nop
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .word   entry
        .word   entry - .
